secure_enabled.description: Use HTTPS instead of HTTP when communicating with speedtest.net operated servers.

bytes_mode.description: Display values in bytes instead of bits.

simple_output.description: Suppress verbose output, only show basic information.

csv_output.description: Suppress verbose output, only show basic information in CSV format.

csv_delimiter.description: Single character delimiter to use in CSV output.

json_output.description: Suppress verbose output, only show basic information in JSON format.

server_ids.description: Specify a server ID to test against. Can be supplied multiple times.

excluded_servers.description: Exclude a server from selection. Can be supplied multiple times.

mini_server_url.description: URL of the Speedtest Mini server.

source_ip.description: Source IP address to bind to.

single_connection.description: Only use a single connection instead of multiple.

no_pre_allocate.description: Do not pre allocate upload data.

share_results.description: Generate and provide a URL to the speedtest.net share results image.
